## How to play

**Setup, before the pull:** **Dismiss Pet**: **Lone Wolf** only works while you have no pet out.

**Before the pull:** **Hunter's Mark**, **Aspect of the Hawk**, **Sniper Shot**.

**Keep up all fight:** **Aspect of the Hawk**.

**Then press the first one that is ready**, top to bottom:

1. **Hunter's Mark** and **Serpent Sting**: keep them on the target
2. **Arcane Shot**
3. **Aimed Shot**
4. **Sniper Shot**

Between these, **Auto Shot** keeps firing on its own.

**Advanced: your cooldowns and extras.** Once the list above feels easy, add these:

- **Rapid Fire**: a cooldown, use it at the start of the fight and again whenever it is ready (about 1 time a fight)
- Use your trinkets and a potion together with your big cooldowns.

*The simulator's full rotation for this build, with every condition: [research rotation page](../research/raid/rotation.md).*

## Why this rotation

Lone Wolf Marksmanship raids with no pet out: keep **Hunter's Mark** and **Serpent Sting** on the boss, then fire **Arcane Shot**, **Aimed Shot** and **Sniper Shot**, in that order, whenever one is ready. This is the official simulator's own turret rotation (since 2026-11-20; on this build it ties ours, +0.02%, and leads by 0.1-1.7% for the entry's other builds). In a 3-minute raid fight: **Arcane Shot** 37 casts, **Aimed Shot** 19, **Serpent Sting** 12, **Sniper Shot** 10, **Rapid Fire** 1; **Auto Shot** 39% of the damage, **Arcane Shot** 22%, **Aimed Shot** 17%, **Serpent Sting** 14%, **Sniper Shot** 9%.

**Why it works**

- Setup: **Dismiss Pet** (a 5-second cast), since **Lone Wolf**'s 20% to all your attacks counts only with no pet out. Cast **Trueshot Aura** too: in Forever a 30-minute buff (rank 5: +100 ranged attack power to your party and raid within 45 yards), which the simulator applies for you, so it has no line.
- The opener: **Hunter's Mark** and **Aspect of the Hawk** 22 and 20 seconds before the pull, then **Sniper Shot** started 4 seconds before so it lands as the fight begins. The aspect is what **Deadly Aspects** needs: each **Auto Shot** has a 10% chance to speed your shots by 30% for 12 seconds.
- **Hunter's Mark** and **Serpent Sting** whenever missing from the boss: the mark lasts 2 minutes, the sting 15 seconds (12 casts, recast as it falls off; 20% stronger with **Improved Stings**). Each sting starts **Rapid Recuperation**: half your mana regeneration keeps going while you cast for 15 seconds.
- **Arcane Shot** whenever it is ready: **Improved Arcane Shot** brings its cooldown to 4.5 seconds, 37 casts a fight, the most of any button.
- **Aimed Shot** next: +350 to a shot, 15% more with **Barrage**, a 2-second cast on a 6-second cooldown. **Multi-Shot** shares that cooldown and is switched off for a single target ("Use Multi-Shot").
- **Sniper Shot** last: ranged damage plus 590 on a 4-second cast and a 15-second cooldown. The rotation's own note calls it the least damage per second of casting, so it waits until neither shot above is ready.
- From 5 seconds in, every other cooldown as it comes ready: **Rapid Fire** (40% faster attacks for 15 seconds) once, your on-use trinket (the page's sets carry Blackhand's Breadth) and a Major Mana Potion. **Rapid Killing** cuts **Rapid Fire** to 3 minutes, a second one only past 3 minutes 5 seconds; the build takes it because **Rapid Recuperation** requires it.

**Caveats**

- Full raid: every raid buff and debuff, phase-1 gear, 3-minute fights. The list has no mana guard: on the simulator's training dummy (your own buffs only), the raid's mana buffs alone (Mana Spring Totem, Mana Tide Totem, Greater Blessing of Wisdom, Judgement of Wisdom) add 32% to this build's damage. **Efficiency** makes your shots and stings 9% cheaper.
- Moving: **Auto Shot**, **Aimed Shot** and **Sniper Shot** need you to stand still; **Arcane Shot** and **Serpent Sting** are instant. Do not start a 4-second **Sniper Shot** when you must move soon; move right after an **Auto Shot** goes off, as the simulator's walk to its spot does ("Windup close", "Just shot").
- Track the boss's creature type: **Improved Tracking** adds 5% only against the tracked type, and a Mechanical boss has none to track. The simulator's boss is an Elemental, so its numbers carry the full 5%.
- **Rapid Killing**'s other half (a kill makes your next Shot within 20 seconds hit 20% harder) never happens on a boss; on trash, let the next pull's first **Aimed Shot** spend it.
- Ranks: the list casts the trainer's top ranks, **Serpent Sting** rank 8 and **Aspect of the Hawk** rank 6 (ranks 9 and 7 are class books, not in Forever on the evidence there is; checked again when the raids open on 2026-12-09). For **Hunter's Mark** the simulator uses rank 3's +98 ranged attack power, as the client data it reads lists rank 4 lower; the beta tooltip (build 70753) reads rank 4 +143. Cast whichever rank your tooltip shows higher.

**When to change it**

- Two or three targets close together: **Multi-Shot** in place of **Aimed Shot** (it hits 3 targets). For a pack, **Volley**: a 6-second channel with no cooldown.
- In the last seconds, skip the **Serpent Sting** recast and do not start a **Sniper Shot** that will not land before the boss dies.
- With a pet instead: the page's With a pet setup (7/39/5: Focused Fire in place of **Lone Wolf** and a point of **Efficiency**) plays these shots with a cat out, 981 DPS in a full raid against this build's 996. Its entry runs the official turret file with our search's edits of 2026-11-20; with no **Summon Hawk** talent, the only one that acts for it is a Major Mana Potion line at the end (two potions a fight, not one), and on the official file it does 973.5.
- Short on mana: let **Sniper Shot** go first. In this build's full-raid numbers it does about 1,670 damage for 365 mana, **Aimed Shot** 1,540 for 310, **Arcane Shot** 1,060 for 190, **Serpent Sting** 2,050 for 230.
